name: VRPorn.com
summary: The biggest dedicated VR porn hub: daily-updated VR videos and games, a streaming/download player, and a library that markets itself as working across every major headset. Founded as a VR fan site in 2013, adult-focused since 2016, Los Angeles based.
ranking_rationale: Filled the VR slot as the established category hub, chosen on our own editorial call — first-party pages verified live (official FAQ/contact), plus press-profile history. The portal earns from affiliate placement across studio partners, so it is the VR desk's directory pick, not a hands-on winner.

pricing.model: Mixed — free teaser videos, per-studio memberships sold through partner sites
pricing.free_tier: Free video sections and games exist; full downloads route through partner studios
pricing.notes: Site-level price not first-party verified at check time; partner-studio pricing varies. Confirm on the site.

pros: Largest dedicated VR library with daily updates
Includes VR games and interactive-toy integration
cons: It is a hub: the actual memberships are the partner studios it links to
Site-level pricing is spread across partners

facts.value: Created 2013 as a VR fan site; shifted to adult content in 2016; based in Los Angeles
Site restricted to adults 18+ (or age of consent), with explicit visual depictions
Official FAQ covers general, technical, and billing questions
Highest-traffic VR adult site per 2017 Wikipedia reports (8M+ monthly visits)
